title: Production Learning & Cross-Service Trial Review VII
method: Read-only connected Supabase SELECT: statement_timestamp plus 16 direct canonical source counts. No identity, wage, client, address, rate or field payloads retrieved.

decision.reason: No registered PMS companies, company-scoped Jobs, field receipts, or original customer/property links in the inspected Production sources; no ten-first-job cohort per service/period.
decision.scope_note: A zero count in named tables is not proof that unrecorded or offline work did not occur. Software CI and Vercel GREEN are independent of owner field-trial acceptance.

synthetic_company_admin_fixture.scope: one synthetic company, no real Supabase Auth identity

bounded_next_build_priorities.reason: Gated company navigation and module ON/OFF rules before new service entry points.
Owner-scoped clients/properties and onboarding evidence; real cohorts cannot exist without these.
Accounting permissions shell before exposing broader payroll/cost/ledger data.
First standalone Lawn & Grounds field workflow with original Jobs and property proof.
Separate Snow Removal and Plowing modules with original winter field events.
Private employee/HR records with strict wage isolation.
Review-only payroll readiness after employee/role guard, no real pay run.
Double-entry sandbox and reconciled native financial ledger with manual approvals.
Separate septic field disposal and tree/arboricultural permissions.
Construction, concrete, fibre and excavation permits and evidence.
Company-scoped job costing and wage-redacted financial comparison.
End-to-end module, tenancy, accessibility and exact Production acceptance before operational adoption.

boundary: This dated review only queries original sources. The owner 442 RPC is separate, read-only and requires verified company ownership; neither channel makes employee/payroll, invoice, payment, safety or customer writes.
